nodes.description: SlotTicket public token created in the Slot constructor and minted to ticket buyers
mapping(uint => address) participants; index-to-address table of ticket buyers used to pick winners
uint256[] prizes; fixed payout schedule [4 ether,2 ether,1 ether,500 finney x5]
uint8 counter; running index of issued tickets, reset conceptually per game
uint256 jackpot accumulator credited with 245 finney per draw and zeroed on payout
uint256 gameNumber; incremented at the end of every awardPrizes draw
address wallet; cash-register recipient set by the constructor and by changeWallet
uint8 constant SIZE = 100; lottery window size
uint32 constant JACKPOT_SIZE = 1000000; jackpot probability denominator
uint256 constant PRICE = 100 finney; per-ticket price
address public owner; privileged address from Ownable
bool public paused; emergency stop flag of Pausable
mapping(address => uint256) balances; ERC20 balances in BasicToken
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowances in StandardToken
uint256 public totalSupply; mintable token supply
Slot fallback function() payable; buys tickets for msg.sender
buyTicketsFor(address beneficiary) payable whenNotPaused; issues tickets and refunds change
addParticipant(address,uint8) private; registers participants and triggers drawing
rand(uint32,uint256) constant private; pseudo-random generator using block.blockhash
awardPrizes(uint256) private; draws winners, pays prizes, jackpot cut and gas refund
distributeJackpot(uint256) internal payout of the accumulated jackpot
Slot.destroy() onlyOwner; destroys the child token and selfdestructs
changeWallet(address) onlyOwner; updates the cash-register wallet
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256); ERC20 transfer using SafeMath
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256); allowance based transfer
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256); sets allowance with zero-allowance require
SlotTicket.mint(address,uint256) onlyOwner; mints tickets
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner; transfers ownership
Pausable.pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false
SlotTicket.destroy() onlyOwner; selfdestructs the token contract
BasicToken.balanceOf(address) constant; returns balances[_owner]
msg.sender: untrusted caller of the fallback/buyTicketsFor path, becomes beneficiary, ERC20 balance holder and refund recipient
msg.sender: untrusted caller of addParticipant/awardPrizes, drives the draw and is refunded 10 finney of gas
selfdestruct(owner) inside Slot.destroy()
selfdestruct(owner) inside SlotTicket.destroy()
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value%PRICE): external Ether transfer to an untrusted caller
token.mint(beneficiary, numberOfTickets): external call into the mintable token
participants[winnerIndex+i].transfer(prizes[i]): external Ether transfer to an arbitrary participant address
participants[_winnerIndex].transfer(jackpot): external Ether transfer to the jackpot winner
wallet.transfer(245 finney): fixed Ether transfer to the cash-register wallet
msg.sender.transfer(10 finney): external gas refund to the untrusted caller
uint32(sha3(block.blockhash(block.number-1), _seed))%_size: miner-influenceable weak randomness
winnerIndex -= SIZE wrap-around arithmetic past end boundary (underflow / out-of-window index)
uint8 counter++ inside the ticket loop: counter can overflow and alias previous participant slots
Slot(address _wallet) constructor: deploys SlotTicket and sets wallet
constructor parameter _wallet
beneficiary address receiving the tickets
_participant address inserted into participants
_numberOfTickets uint8 loop bound and randomness seed source
_size uint32 modulus for the pseudo-random draw

_seed uint256 passed from addParticipant into awardPrizes/rand
_winnerIndex index of the jackpot winner
_newWallet address replacing wallet

ERC20 transfer amount
source address of transferFrom
destination address of transferFrom
amount of transferFrom
spender granted the allowance
allowance amount granted
mint recipient
minted amount
new owner address

loop index i over the number of tickets
uint32 winningNumber produced by rand
bool jackpotWon flag from the second rand call

edges.reason: fallback forwards the paying caller to buyTicketsFor(msg.sender)
untrusted msg.sender enters the contract through the payable fallback
msg.sender is used as the beneficiary argument of buyTicketsFor
beneficiary participates in the ticket purchase and mint path
buyTicketsFor performs msg.sender.transfer for the change, an external call to an untrusted address
the refund recipient of msg.sender.transfer is the attacker-controlled caller
the change refund can invoke the fallback of an attacker contract and re-enter the lottery
buyTicketsFor calls the external mintable token during the purchase
buyTicketsFor delegates participant registration and the draw to addParticipant
the computed numberOfTickets is passed as _numberOfTickets to addParticipant
counter is uint8 and is incremented on every ticket, so it can overflow
participants[counter] is written with the participant address
addParticipant triggers a draw when counter % (SIZE-1) == 0
awardPrizes calls rand to derive the winning numbers
rand derives its output from block.blockhash, a miner-influenceable value used as randomness
winnerIndex -= SIZE wrap-around can push the index below the window or underflow
awardPrizes distributes the jackpot when the jackpot condition holds
awardPrizes pays each prize with an external transfer to a participant address
a prize recipient contract can re-enter through the payable fallback while prizes are being paid
distributeJackpot transfers the jackpot to the winner with an external call
the jackpot transfer can re-enter the lottery through the fallback before jackpot is zeroed
awardPrizes refunds gas to msg.sender with an external transfer
the untrusted caller is the direct recipient of the gas refund transfer
msg.sender pays the gas for the draw and is refunded, making the caller value part of the payout flow
awardPrizes forwards the fixed 245 finney cash-register cut to wallet
distributeJackpot reads and then zeroes jackpot before it is re-credited
awardPrizes increments jackpot by a fixed 245 finney after each draw
gameNumber is incremented at the end of each draw
prizes array is indexed to determine each payout amount
SIZE defines the participant window start/end of the draw
JACKPOT_SIZE sets the jackpot probability denominator
PRICE converts msg.value into a ticket count and change amount
buyTicketsFor is gated by the whenNotPaused modifier reading paused
the constructor writes the wallet state variable from its argument
Slot.destroy executes selfdestruct(owner)
Slot.destroy calls token.destroy() on the child token contract
SlotTicket.destroy executes selfdestruct(owner)
changeWallet updates the wallet state variable (onlyOwner protected)
transfer rewrites balances using SafeMath sub/add
msg.sender is the debited account in BasicToken.transfer
transferFrom mutates allowed[_from][msg.sender] relying on sub revert instead of an explicit require
transferFrom updates both balances entries
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and the zero-allowance require mitigates the approval race
mint grows totalSupply through SafeMath add
mint credits the recipient balances entry
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable (onlyOwner protected)
pause sets the paused flag (onlyOwner, whenNotPaused)
unpause clears the paused flag (onlyOwner, whenPaused)
cached _allowance is decremented and written back in transferFrom
loop index i drives participant slot allocation in addParticipant
winningNumber selects the winner slot inside awardPrizes
jackpotWon gates the distributeJackpot call
start anchors the participant window of the current game
end bounds the wrap-around index check
winnerIndex is the variable mutated by the -= SIZE wrap-around
loop index i selects the prize amount and recipient for each external transfer
_winnerIndex selects the jackpot transfer recipient
the caller supplied seed is mixed into the blockhash based randomness
_seed is hashed with the previous blockhash to produce the pseudo-random number
